basic_info.description: Introducing a remarkable condominium in the desirable Candlestick Cove neighborhood, where tranquility meets modern elegance. This fully updated residence features a spacious layout with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, thoughtfully designed to provide optimal privacy.    The kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, equipped with brand-new stainless-steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and sleek quartz countertops. The living-dining great room offers a welcoming space for relaxation and entertainment.    This residence beautifully blends city living with a serene retreat, perfect for those who enjoy the vibrancy of San Francisco while valuing a peaceful atmosphere and convenient access to the South Bay and Peninsula.    Additional highlights include two deeded parking spaces conveniently located next to the elevator, a generous closet, and a double vanity in the primary bedroom. This gated community offers 24/7 onsite security, a fitness center, and a picnic area, ideal for enjoying the warm weather. With an in-unit washer and dryer, this move-in ready home is the perfect sanctuary to call your own.
